title: Portable grants form architecture: initial proof package
summary: A compact index of reproducible technical evidence for portable declarative forms. It separates observed compatibility from semantic, accessibility, policy, and release acceptance.

claims.title: SF-424 has a bounded real-runtime comparison and compatibility receipt
claims.statement: A generic lower-environment path creates existing and portable applications, exercises render, conditional interaction, validation, save and reload, and print, and emits a pinned side-by-side receipt and recording.
reproduce: git clone https://github.com/mikec-ai/simpler-grants-gov.git
git checkout 3087b7be0d30c05be5558159208afb7201cfd9e0
Follow api/src/form_schema/form_spec/README.md under 'side-by-side SF-424 demonstration'
limitations: The generated receipt and video are build outputs, not versioned source files.
The merged fork evidence is not a production registration or approval.

claims.title: Seven forms use one uniform comparison; one passes and six remain blocked
claims.statement: At the pinned consumer merge, one form-agnostic mechanism compares SF-424, SF-424 Short, SF-424A, Key Contacts, Project Abstract Summary, Project Narrative Attachments, and SF-424B. One form passes because all supported dimensions match exactly. Six forms are blocked because their observed differences are mechanically bounded but remain proposed and unaccepted. There are zero unexplained failures. Across 28 supported form-dimension results, 15 report parity, 12 report proposed deltas, one is not applicable, and zero report reviewed deltas. The portable ledger contains 50 exact-key records: 16 are source-verified, all 50 remain proposed, and zero are accepted. Project Narrative Attachments has exact parity in the supported schema, UI, validation, and rule-declaration dimensions; unexpected differences, stale allowances, or unverified acceptance fail closed.

evidence.label: Uniform cohort declaration, comparator, and fail-closed tests

reproduce: Clone simpler-grants-gov and check out 29fafef5c1f1032b559b519d73387475932297fd
From api, run uv run python bin/build_portable_legacy_differential.py --consumer-revision 29fafef5c1f1032b559b519d73387475932297fd --output-dir test-results/legacy-differential

Inspect api/test-results/legacy-differential/summary.json and the seven adjacent per-form receipts; inspect the vendored parity ledger to confirm 16 of 50 records are source-verified and all 50 remain proposed
limitations: The comparison gate covers applicant-visible schema constraints and requiredness, the UI declaration, validation verdicts over a mechanically generated mutation corpus, and rule-schema declarations only.
Serialized XML, rule outcomes, and runtime lifecycle behavior are explicitly unavailable in this static mechanism; rule-declaration parity is not rule-outcome parity.
Existing Simpler behavior is a compatibility oracle rather than source or semantic authority, and a mechanically bounded proposed difference is not semantic acceptance.
This technical receipt is not release readiness, human accessibility review, policy approval, or production registration.

claims.title: Reviewed pairwise similarity is currently unavailable; exploratory similarity remains separate
claims.statement: The analysis export reports zero accepted form-question occurrence mappings. It therefore leaves every reviewed pairwise count and similarity value blank while publishing implementation-derived exploratory similarity in a separate artifact.

evidence.label: Analysis export contract and review boundary

reproduce: Clone grants-form-spec with full Git history and check out 243e5951b883b9b521c24567a5e362d9bfdd7f19
Run npm ci && npm run emit && npm run project-evidence
Run python3 scripts/analyze.py --json --output-dir build/analysis > /dev/null
Inspect build/analysis/pairwise-reviewed.csv, build/analysis/pairwise-exploratory.csv, and build/analysis/form-analysis.json
limitations: Reviewed semantic similarity is unavailable because the current evidence has zero accepted occurrence mappings; blank reviewed values must not be read as zero similarity.
Exploratory similarity uses implementation-derived canonical identities and is not published semantic coverage.
The analysis files are generated build outputs and are not committed to the runtime source tree.

releaseBoundaries: Technical compatibility evidence is not human semantic acceptance.
Automated accessibility checks are not human accessibility approval.
Existing runtime behavior is a compatibility oracle, not semantic authority.
No evidence in this package constitutes policy approval or production registration.
Proposed or unreviewed mappings do not contribute to published coverage metrics.
